name: Alila Anji
insider_take: This eco-luxury retreat nestled in Anji's famous bamboo forests offers a serene escape where sustainability meets sophistication.
whats_special: Alila Anji is built within China's largest bamboo forest reserve, where the movie "Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon" was filmed. The property features architecture that seamlessly blends into the natural landscape, with floor-to-ceiling windows offering panoramic views of endless bamboo groves. The hotel sits at 1,000 meters above sea level, providing naturally cool temperatures year-round.
pro_tip: Visit during early morning hours when mist rolls through the bamboo forest, creating an ethereal atmosphere perfect for photography and meditation walks.
dont_miss: The bamboo forest cable car ride offering bird's-eye views of the verdant canopy, and the nearby Tianhuangping pumped-storage power station - one of Asia's largest. The hotel's spa treatments using locally-sourced bamboo extracts provide the ultimate wellness experience after exploring the tranquil hiking trails.
pros: Stunning bamboo forest setting with natural tranquility
Exceptional spa treatments using local wellness traditions
Farm-to-table dining with locally sourced ingredients
cons: Limited nightlife and urban entertainment options
